desc:
💥 A GIANT DUMMY IS WRECKING THE CITY. YOU’RE THE HERO. 💥

Pick your superhero, fly into a city at sunset, and beat the giant dummy into the pavement. Fireballs, tornadoes, punches and ults send it ragdolling through buildings, and the whole city breaks around you.

🦸 Choose your hero: every hero has its own powers, weapons and perks
🏙️ Destroy everything: buildings crumble from every hit
👹 Become the GIANT: At anytime anyone has the opportunity to purchase the opportunity to be the giant
☄️ Server events: Meteor Showers, Golden Giants and Giant Hordes pay out RP for everyone
✊ Get grabbed? Bust out of the giant’s fist before it eats you
📱 Fully playable on phone, PC and console

Earn RP, unlock new heroes, and see how hard you can break the dummy.

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite for updates and new heroes!
